name: KIMSHEALTH Trivandrum
summary: KIMSHEALTH Trivandrum is the flagship hospital of the KIMSHEALTH group in Thiruvananthapuram, with 900 beds. In 2006 it became the first hospital in India to hold both an international (ACHSI) and a national (NABH) accreditation, per the group.
highlights: Accredited by the Australian Council on Healthcare Standards International (ACHSI) and by NABH since 2006
Eight accreditations in all, including NABL for the laboratory and NABH for nursing, imaging, blood bank and emergency
900 beds across the flagship campus and KIMSHEALTH East
Part of Aster DM Quality Care
